name: ultimate-prompt-library
description: The open-source library of deep, production-grade AI prompts.

scripts.validate: npm run validate:prompts && npm run validate:translations && npm run validate:links && npm run validate:generated && npm run validate:v2 && npm test && npm run sources:check -- --offline && npm run validate:site
scripts.validate:v2: node scripts/validate-v2.mjs && node scripts/export-v2-evals.mjs && node scripts/run-v2-evals.mjs --prompt=UPL-IT-031 --lang=en --max-fixtures=6 && node scripts/run-v2-evals.mjs --prompt=UPL-HEALTH-021 --lang=sr --max-fixtures=6 && node scripts/run-v2-evals.mjs --manifest=evals/manifests/baseline-smoke.json
scripts.generate: npm run index && npm run stats
scripts.build: npm run validate:prompts && npm run validate:translations && npm run validate:links && npm run validate:generated && npm run validate:v2 && npm run build:site && node scripts/validate-site.mjs
